title: Lucid’s ‘fire risk’ recall was for LED lights & already fixed by a July software update
summary: A number of headlines have made a big deal out of Lucid’s recall of 27k vehicles for an apparent fire risk. But the problem had to do with an electronic fuse controlling LED lights, and a software update distributed last month already fixed the overheating issue.

title: Survey Sunday: will the Ford Fathom steal Slate Auto’s thunder?
summary: For the last few weeks, we’ve been running a sidebar survey about whether Electrek readers believed the announcement of Ford’s upcoming, all-electric $30,000 Fathom pickup would sink Bezos-backed startup Slate Auto before it even got to set sail. After nearly 2,700 responses, here’s what you told us.

title: Amazon’s massive 2026 Labor Day sale now live! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, more from under $5
summary: The official 2026 Amazon Labor Day Sale is now live. Featuring thousands and thousands of price drops across just about every product category, the Amazon Labor Day Sale has now taken the site over with deals on everything from AirPods Pro 3 and AirTag 2 through to Bose headphones, Anker charging gear, OLED TVs, coffee makers, smart home upgrades, and just about everything in between. Check it out right here and head below for more details.

title: Slate will offer a high roof cargo version of its compact pickup – and you can buy it!
summary: Bezos-backed Slate Auto is serious about the commercial truck market, and the company’s Fleet Business Development team shared some of the most detailed information about the rumored high roof cargo kit yet at the brand’s ongoing Portland ride-along event.

title: E-quipment highlight: Tiger electric baggage tug hauls 30 TONS [video]
summary: The Tiger Li-Ion electric baggage tug is quietly revolutionizing the airport ground handling and ground support equipment (GSE) market with silent, emission-free running, massive fuel savings, and a 60,000 lb. (!) payload capacity.

title: 666 – il marchio della Spiaggia Lucciola Elettrica con un ricarico del 13 percento
summary: The numbers 666 and 13 don’t have the best of reputations in certain circles, but Chinese car brand Nio hopes its latest Firefly hatchback will have better luck with them – offering a limited run of 666 special edition EVs at a price that’s 13% higher than usual.

title: MacGregor says demand for its electric cranes is BOOMING in 2026
summary: Demand for MacGregor’s maritime cranes has been strong in the first half of 2026, and Swedish heavy lift experts say their electric offerings are now making up more than 80% of the company’s new crane orders.

title: Robot delivery dog dumps hot steaming packages on your doorstep [video]
summary:
The new R-dog delivery robot hopes to replace your local gig-workers with a friendly face, red cap, approachable design, and even furry tail – all cute and adorable, until it poops your package onto your porch.

Oh, and it runs ads the entire time.

title: Illinois just made 40 mph e-bikes street legal – but there’s a huge catch
summary: Illinois just signed a sweeping new electric bicycle law that, among many other changes, finally answers a question that has been hanging over the rapidly growing market for high-powered electric bikes: What exactly are we supposed to do with all of these 35 and 40 mph “e-bikes” that don’t fit into the normal three-class electric bicycle system?

title: Kia is recalling over 21,000 EV9 SUVs over a faulty airbag issue
summary: Kia issued a recall affecting more than 21,000 EV9 SUVs because the airbag system may fail to detect a child in the front seat.

title: VW Turned The ID. Buzz Into An Electric Camper Van. The U.S. Is Next.
summary: The Volkswagen ID. California Cruise is a simple camper van based on the retro-styled ID. Buzz. A U.S. version is coming too.

title: BYD Is Building Its Ultra-Fast Flash Charging Network At A Ferocious Pace
summary: Its Flash Charging network just hit 10,000 stations and a third of the people using them don't even drive a BYD.

title: Lucid Recalls 27,185 Air Sedans Over Fire Risk, Tells Owners To Park Outside
summary: More than 27,000 Lucid Air sedans are being recalled over a fire risk. The good news? Lucid says the fix is just an OTA update.
